title: What Is the Exposition of a Story?
skills: define exposition as an element of narrative structure
identify exposition in stories and plays
analyze how exposition establishes setting, characters, and conflict
explain how exposition prepares readers for later plot development
alignment_note: Introduces exposition as the opening portion of a narrative that establishes essential context such as setting, characters, background, and initial conflict. Supports plot analysis, narrative structure, close reading, and story planning across high school English courses.
